_readme: The printable poster pages (/poster/ and /es/poster/; the Spanish poster is the only Spanish printable). en and es must have the same keys. Plain text. 'hero' and 'panel' are the screen page around the poster; 'poster' is printed on the poster itself (with i18n landing.eyebrow, landing.subline, landing.gloss, legacies.*, labels.* and contact.body). The date, times, Zoom ID, passcode, QR codes, domain and questions address come from site.json, when.js and brand/qr/; write any of them in this file only as tokens ({date}, {dateEs}…). scripts/pdf.mjs renders the #poster element to brand/poster/ (Letter and A4 PDF, 300-dpi PNG).

meta.title: Printable poster
meta.description: A printer-friendly one-page poster for The Incredible Tapestry, {date}: Letter or A4, light background, with QR codes for Zoom and this website. Download it as a PDF or PNG, or print it.

hero.title: Printable poster
hero.lead: One page with a light background that’s easy on a home printer. Both QR codes work from paper: one opens the Zoom meeting, the other this website.
